findings.note: The last paragraph says "San Mateo County's code requires owners to clear a hoarded home within 30 days." No ledger claim supports it (clm:1 to clm:4 are all San Francisco Housing Code 351), there is no stored San Mateo County official print or quote, and it states a specific local legal rule with a figure (30 days) as certain. It also sits next to a San Francisco rule, which invites the reader to think the two counties match (SR-2). Remove it, or Leo must supply the official San Mateo County code print and a claim for it.

"It says nothing about any other city or county." is an absence-of-law statement with no statute_absence claim (SR-6). Drop the sentence. Also "This is a San Francisco rule, not California law." opens the section before any rule is stated; attach it to the rule sentence (for example "Under the City and County of San Francisco's Housing Code section 351(a), ...  This is a San Francisco rule, not California law.").
